title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Reschedule Allowances by Service Level
content:
Members may move a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment within limits that each service level sets: whether the appointment may be moved to the date the request is made, how many calendar days must separate the request date from the booked date for a move to be free, how many moves made with that notice are free, the fee for a move made without notice or beyond the free moves, and the most times the appointment can be moved.

| Service level | Move to the request date itself | Notice for a free move | Free moves with notice | Reschedule fee | Most moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | Not allowed | 1 calendar day | 2 | $15.00 | 3 |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | Not allowed | 1 calendar day | 2 | $25.00 | 3 |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | Not allowed | 2 calendar days | 2 | $35.00 | 3 |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | Not allowed | 2 calendar days | 2 | $50.00 | 3 |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | Not allowed | 2 calendar days | 1 | $50.00 | 2 |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | Not allowed | 2 calendar days | 1 | $50.00 | 2 |

## Notes

- No level allows a same-day move: an appointment is never moved to the date on which the request is made.
- The two installation levels allow 1 free move and 2 moves in all; every other level allows 2 free moves and 3 moves in all.
- The reschedule fee rises with the level, from $15.00 at Northgate Curbside Delivery to $50.00 at White Glove and both installation levels.
